intro_text: Passionate about the web and constantly seeking new opportunities to grow and innovate.
bio_text1: Hello! I'm Joel. Currently looking to change my career after completing my Web Development training with OpenClassrooms. I learned the basics of web languages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), as well as API creation, data management, site optimization and creation with React. In addition, having a bachelor’s degree in Graphic Production, I am also proficient in tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
bio_text2: I'm tech-savvy and driven by a constantly growing curiosity. My passion for front-end development, especially with React, drives me to explore new possibilities. Below are some of the projects I've had the opportunity to work on during my studies.
bio_text3: Concurrently, I'm a film enthusiast and co-creator of Eteindez la lumière, a podcast dedicated to cinema. In this independent project, I wear several hats: co-host, editor and website maintenance manager.
